response.rationale: ClubBooking has its own repository (ClubBookingRepository, node 440da90bcde7901a, src/persistence/clubBookingRepository.ts: "private readonly bookings = new Map<string, ClubBooking>();"). Only ClubService (book, getRate, setRate, invoice, list) and RinkService.effectiveCapacity use it, which suggests clubs booking ice time with rates and invoices. Booking is reached through a different BookingRepository: IceMonitorService (node f59a45a01c2ed338, src/business/iceMonitorService.ts) calls "this.bookings.listBySession(session.id)", which fits per-session bookings that get notified through DropTextClient. The separate repositories and different behaviours point to two distinct concepts that only share the word 'booking'. I could not see either type definition, so this is inferred from usage.
